name: Rocks / Old Fashioned
note: The short, heavy-based tumbler spirit-forward drinks are served over ice in. Capacity is to the brim; a drink is poured well short of it.
iceDisplacementNote: Solid ice only — the liquid fills the gaps between pieces, so what has to be subtracted from the glass is the ice itself. Cubed assumes six to eight tray cubes near 2.5 cm; block assumes one 5 cm cube, which is why the two land in the same place from opposite directions. Crushed is taken as 7% above cubed: loose crushed ice weighs about 593 to 640 kg per cubic metre against 917 for solid ice, roughly 65% solid, where loose cubes run about 61%.
